description.value: Takysie Lake Resort is a secluded, family-run lakeside retreat in BC's Central Interior, sitting on a 514-hectare rainbow trout lake whose name means 'lake of many fishes.' The resort offers rustic lakeside cabins, RV and tent sites, a boat launch, guest docks, and floatplane docking, making it a self-contained base camp for fishing, paddling, and exploring the remote Southside backroads. On-site amenities include a café, general market, hardware store, 24-hour pay-at-pump gas station, and a mechanic shop — an unusually full-service stop for such a remote location.

address.value: 37530 Eakin Settlement Road, Burns Lake BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is extensive and confirms an active, family-run lakeside resort near Burns Lake with cabins, RV/tent sites, an on-site café, market store, hardware store, gas station, and mechanic shop; the site recently changed ownership (summer 2024) and is clearly operational with online booking. No mention of secure bike storage, staff bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the content. The on-site Takysie Café and Takysie Market Store support true values for 'Nearby evening food' and 'Nearby grocery' since they are physically co-located at the resort.
concerns: OSM tags the property as 'tourism=hotel' but it is primarily a cabin/campground resort — the tag is a minor mismatch but not consequential.
Phone and address were absent from OSM; values taken from website footer (250-694-3403 / 37530 Eakin Settlement Road, Burns Lake BC).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible lakeside resort with online booking, recent blog activity (June 2025), and a full suite of on-site services that would be genuinely useful to a touring cyclist in a remote area.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Takysie Café serves comfort food; open most days including weekends starting at 9am

Nearby grocery.detail: On-site Takysie Market Store open daily 9am–9pm; website says 'stock up on supplies.'
